label: STRICT_PURE_ACTUALITY_2: Every real determination of a first mover is a pure perfection: for every…
definition: Every real determination of a first mover is a pure perfection: for every first mover f and every d with Has f d, Pure d.
note: Open, unattributed. It is stronger than PureAct (no potency in any motion respect), than having no parts and than esse not other than essence: it also excludes a real individuating principle that is not itself a pure actuality. The rival it denies holds that a thisness can be a real positive entity without being a perfection.
